verdict.rationale: Luma is an AI video generation platform, so creating a custom avatar of a real person is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows only adjacent features: character references, transforming people into new characters, and facial-expression transfer. Nothing documents creating a custom avatar of a real person, and nothing documents a consent or verification flow.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can create a custom avatar of a real person through a documented consent and verification flow
